fixture_note: The agent's workspace is a flat copy of this fixture's src/ contents only (design.md Decision 4), so the relative path an agent reports is relative to that copy's root, not to this repo tree.

tool_sets.forbidden_mechanism: SCOPED arm: invisible via --disallowedTools naming every built-in tool except Glob, Grep, Read, plus every currently-connected MCP tool name (mcp_servers stays at its full count in both arms). BROAD arm: no scoping flag is used; the same names are visible but judged only by the practice check, never blocked.

checker_self_test._purpose: R-A1.4: every detector the rig relies on must be proven able to fire, not merely specified. These are synthetic transcript fragments for rig/derive.py (not yet built) to run against once it exists — they do not require a live model run.

negative_control._purpose: R-A1.7: a reported defect whose file was never Read in the transcript must be classified practice=fail (cell=improper-success when outcome=pass).

off_set_case._purpose: The off-set detector must have a case where an off-set tool is called, in both arms, without affecting outcome or practice pass/fail.
